brief: 6 kitchen tools that replaced 30 — minimalist home cook edition.

slots.headline: Can One Tool Replace Ten?
slots.subtitle: Six essentials that cleared my counters for good.

slots.title: One Serious Chef's Knife
slots.body: Stop collecting single-purpose blades. A sharp chef's knife trims, slices, and breaks down everything from herbs to whole chickens.

slots.title: Cast-Iron Skillet Workhorse
slots.body: Sear steaks, bake cornbread, and roast vegetables in the same pan. It replaces non-stick skillets, sheet trays, and griddles easily.

slots.title: Heavy Enameled Dutch Oven
slots.body: Simmer soups, braise meat, bake bread, and fry without splatter. One pot covers slow-cooking, roasting, and boiling duties perfectly.

slots.title: Microplane Zester Grater
slots.body: Grate parmesan, zest citrus, mince garlic, and shave nutmeg with ease. It replaces four bulky gadgets and one box grater.

slots.title: Immersion Blender Stick
slots.body: Puree soup directly in the pot, whip cream, and blend smoothies in one jar. No bulky base or multiple attachments needed.

slots.title: Digital Kitchen Scale
slots.body: Weigh flour, coffee, and portions directly into one bowl. It eliminates stacks of measuring cups and spoons instantly.
